home.heroSubtitle: A sanctuary of rest and botanical delights
home.welcomeText: Experience the unique harmony between a boutique hotel and Jardin Coffee. Whether you're seeking a peaceful night's rest in our curated rooms or a vibrant workspace surrounded by greenery, Qafotel is your home in the heart of the city.
home.feature1Text: Discover our two signature room types, designed for ultimate relaxation with organic textures and modern amenities.
home.feature2Text: Sip on artisan coffee and enjoy fresh pastries in our greenhouse-inspired café, the perfect spot for work or leisure.

about.heroText: Discover the story behind our botanical sanctuary, where every corner is curated for peace and organic connection.
about.storyText: Founded in 2026, Qafotel began as a dream to merge the tranquility of a lush greenhouse with the comfort of a boutique hotel. We believe that modern travelers deserve more than just a bed—they deserve a breath of fresh air. Our spaces are designed to blur the lines between indoors and outdoors.
about.missionText: “To cultivate an environment where hospitality and nature coexist, providing our guests with a soulful retreat that rejuvenates the spirit through botanical beauty and mindful service.”
about.styleText: Our aesthetic is defined by 'Organic Minimalism'. We use raw materials, earth tones, and hundreds of living plants to create a living, breathing architecture. Hand-drawn accents and rounded edges in our design reflect the fluid, imperfect beauty of the natural world.
